reason: The hypothesis synthesizes separate findings on wear-induced oxide disruption (P2) and micro-galvanic corrosion in eutectic HEAs (P9, P18, P21, P26) into a single, coupled degradation mechanism for simultaneous high-temperature wear and corrosion, a combination not proposed in any single passage. It also specifies a controlled comparison to test this synergy, which goes beyond the individual studies.

localized pitting at phase interfaces (P9, P21)
